from collections.abc import Iterable, Callable, Awaitable


@decorate
async def in_order[T](
    items: Iterable[T],
    step: Callable[[T], Awaitable[None]],
    *,
    reason: str,
) -> None:
    """Run each supplied step."""
    _ = reason
    for item in items:
        await step(item)


async def in_order_steps[T](
    steps: Iterable[Callable[[], Awaitable[T]]], *, reason: str
) -> None:
    """Run the supplied steps."""
    for step in steps:
        await step()


async def in_order[T](items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        await unrelated(item)
